"Wherefore it is most respectfully prayed that in the above noted facts and circumstances, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to quashed the all criminal proceedings of Sessions Trial No.. 1798/2023 (State of U.P. versus Ashish Kashyap)

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In terms of earlier order of this Court dated 11.09.2024, the parties are present in person before this Court today and have been duly identified by their respective counsel.

For the relief sought, quoted above, it is stated that the complainant/ victim/ opposite party No. 2 at the time of lodging of FIR was adult, indisputedly, and she lodged the FIR No. 0164 of 2024 lodged on 23.04.2023 against the applicant making allegation therein to attract offence under Section 323,
376, 3/4 POCSO Act.
However, the allegation that the applicant was establishing physical relations with the opposite party No. 2, aged about 15 years, are completely incorrect.

It is for the reason that as per the FIR itself, the marriage between the applicant and the opposite party No. 2 was settled in the year 2019 and the marriage was to be solemnized on attaining the age of majority in the year 2021 but for some unavoidable reasons, the marriage could not be solemnized and therefore the FIR was lodged on 23.04.2023.

It is stated that during investigation, the opposite party No. 2 supported the story of prosecution,
however, before the trial court, she did not support the story of the prosecution for the reason that in between the marriage was solemnized, which could not be earlier solemnized on account of unavoidable reasons, and accordingly the victim before the trial court stated correct facts.
It is also stated that a bare perusal of the statement of the victim before the trial court would indicate that only on account of non-solemnizing the marriage, the FIR was lodged making allegations to attract offence of rape and POCSO Act.
Before the trial court, she stated that statement under Section 164 CrPC was given only on account of annoyance with the applicant No. 1.

which is part of the record.
It is stated that in view of the aforesaid, the indulgence of this Court is required else the matrimonial life of the applicant and the victim/ opposite party No. 2 would be ruined.
Upon due consideration of the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case including the statement of victim, quoted above, this Court finds that the instant application is liable to be allowed.
